name: Ausweb Internet Services
summary: Central Coast (Gorokan NSW) ISP and web-hosting provider. Site live 'since 13th July 1997' (self-dated 1997 portal); four 1997 APNIC-era allocations (AUSWEBINTERNETS-AU ×4). Offered dial-up, email, Unix shell accounts and web hosting, plus .nu domain registration from 1998. By 2003-05 trading via ausweb.com.au as a webhosting/domain-name business.

events.details: Existing by 1997: four allocations in the 1997 IP Network Index — AUSWEBINTERNETS-AU 203.35.86.0/24, AUSWEBINTERNETS1-AU 203.35.214.0/24, AUSWEBINTERNETS2-AU 203.35.218.0/28, AUSWEBINTERNETS3-AU 203.41.56.0/24 — registered to Ausweb Internet Services, Gorokan NSW. ausweb.net.au captured from 19 Jan 1998 with the site dated 'since 13th July 1997'; services included email accounts (yourname@ausweb.net.au), Unix shell accounts, Windows NT/Unix web hosting, email-list hosting and (from Dec 1998) the .nu domain registry.

events.details: By 2003-05 the business traded as a webhosting and domain-name provider via ausweb.com.au ('AUSWEB ... Webhosting and Domain Names', ©2003; captures to Jul 2005). A separate 'Ausweb.com.au Pty Ltd' (NSW) appears on the ABR (cancelled) — its relationship to the Gorokan ISP is not established.
